summary: German uses sein broadly for copular and locative predication; existential presentation commonly uses es gibt.

semantic_map.SEM.RESULTANT_STATE: sein + result-state adjective/participle where a state reading is intended; distinguish passive/perfect
semantic_map.SEM.EVENT_LOCATION: sein / stattfinden according to event construction
semantic_map.SEM.EXISTENCE_PRESENCE: es gibt + accusative NP; sein can express presence in other contexts
semantic_map.SEM.ABSENCE_NONEXISTENCE: es gibt kein… / nicht vorhanden sein
semantic_map.SEM.ORIGIN_AFFILIATION: aus… sein / kommen aus… / nationality predicate
semantic_map.SEM.POSSESSION_AS_EXISTENCE: not default; haben is ordinary possession
